'''Heas''' was an individual who served as a [[Governor/Legends|governor]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. On one occasion, Heas hired the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Saulis Pau]] to perform an assignment.<ref name="Buyer's Market Galaxy Guide 10">{{WEGCite|story=Buyer's Market (Galaxy Guide 10)|book=Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters}}</ref>
